guards.name: post_gap_reappearance_contradiction
guards.rule: Hook: inside the gap_stop_near_rim MAKE branch (triangulate_shot.py line ~586), before returning MAKE. After gap-stop fires at stop sample (t0, x0,y0,z0), scan the cached in-bounds samples with t > t0 (the same `samples` array — no video needed). Let s1 = first such sample, dt1 = s1.t - t0, r1 = hypot(x1-rim_x, y1-rim_y), speed = 3D dist((x0,y0,z0),(x1,y1,z1))/dt1. Clause R1 (rim-height lateral escape): if dt1 <= 0.6s AND speed < 1200 cm/s AND z1 >= rim_z-25 (>=279.8) AND r1 > 60 -> MISS. Clause R2 (below plane, outside mouth): if dt1 <= 0.8s AND speed < 1200 AND z1 < rim_z-10 (<294.8) AND r1 > 45, and (no second in-bounds sample within 0.3s of s1, or its r >= r1-5, i.e. not converging back under the rim) -> MISS (a ball below the rim plane yet >45cm from rim axis within 0.8s of 'entering the net' is geometrically impossible for a make). Clause R3 (far-floor ricochet): if dt1 <= 1.2s AND z1 < 150 AND r1 > 300 AND >=2 in-bounds samples with z<150 exist in (t0, t0+1.5s] -> MISS. If no reappearance exists, guard is inert and MAKE stands.
guards.pseudo_code:

t0 = post[-1]['t']; x0,y0,z0 = post[-1]['X_cm']
reacq = [s for s in samples if s['t'] > t0]
if reacq:
    s1 = reacq[0]; dt1 = s1['t'] - t0
    x1,y1,z1 = s1['X_cm']; r1 = hypot(x1-rim_x, y1-rim_y)
    speed = dist3d((x0,y0,z0),(x1,y1,z1)) / dt1
    if dt1 <= 0.6 and speed < 1200 and z1 >= rim_z-25 and r1 > 60:
        return info, 'MISS (gap rim-out: reappeared at rim height r=%dcm)' % r1   # R1
    if dt1 <= 0.8 and speed < 1200 and z1 < rim_z-10 and r1 > 45:
        s2 = first in-bounds sample in (s1.t, s1.t+0.3]
        if s2 is None or r(s2) >= r1 - 5:
            return info, 'MISS (gap rim-out: below plane at r=%dcm, outside mouth)' % r1  # R2
    low = [s for s in reacq if s['t'] <= t0+1.5 and s['X_cm'][2] < 150]
    if dt1 <= 1.2 and z1 < 150 and r1 > 300 and len(low) >= 2:
        return info, 'MISS (gap rim-out: rebound on floor at r=%dcm)' % r1        # R3
return info, 'MAKE (gap-stop: ...)'

Companion walker fix: when contact_idx is not None, do not break immediately on pass_through (line ~526-528) — walk up to 8 more samples so the sub-rim tail exists for this check and for the existing bounce-back guard (623ec62d's truncation left a 2-sample tail).
guards.tp_risk: Low-moderate. Most true makes cross at r < 23 + small noise (near the rim the cameras look steeply down, so r noise is ~5-10cm), hence cross_r < 28 and the check never runs. Makes in the 28-40 band pass when their sub-rim samples stay net-confined (r roughly constant, lateral speed < 3 m/s — physically guaranteed inside a net); the in-code June data marks this exact band as depth-contaminated (Y-guard there kills 4/6 FP vs 1/7 TP), and this kinematic check is strictly more permissive for TPs than tightening MAKE_R to 32 would be. Residual risk: detector re-grabbing a different object just below the rim faking divergence — mitigated by extending the walk (more sub-rim samples) and by the 300 cm/s/+12cm conjunction; 2371943d violates by 631 cm/s and +24.8cm, 623ec62d by +22.3cm with verified post-cross r=106.5 at z=271.9.

synthesis.notes: Scope: 17 verified FP findings were supplied from the 30-shot audit (4692eb2b x4, 72c08cb7 x9, e74164e6 x3, 454da9cf x1). Four findings carried adversarial verification (623ec62d, 3a8b45ba, e013a3bf, cf296fb6); all were upheld with no revised modes, so primary failure_mode labels stand as analyzed. Verdict-rule breakdown of the 17: gap-stop 12, smooth-descent 2, rattled-in 2, pass-through 1 — the gap-stop MAKE branch (triangulate_shot.py ~line 499/586) is the dominant FP source and is where guards 1, 3, 4 hook. The recurring physical signal: in 11/12 gap-stop FPs the cached post-stop samples directly contradict 'lost in net' (rim-height lateral reappearance, below-plane-outside-mouth reappearance, far-floor ricochet, or hovering/diverging terminal kinematics); only the data already in the per-shot sample cache is needed — no video. Union coverage: the 6 guards flip 16/17 FPs to MISS and 1/17 (a90a5cda) to UNDECIDED, with heavy overlap (64081bc0 covered by 3 guards, e76cd8b7/cf296fb6/60aefff5/623ec62d/aefd07db/3a8b45ba by 2 each), so individual guard regressions degrade gracefully. Known TP cost from already-measured pieces: ~1/27 TP on the Y-guard clean-cross clause (June data); all newly proposed guards are designed to be inert absent contradicting data or to demote to UNDECIDED in ambiguous bands. Probabilistic kills flagged in-text: 93db4aa3 under guard 3 (rim-dwell vz ~-65 cm/s inferred, not re-derived) and the two cascade kills of guard 2 (aefd07db, 3a8b45ba) which were code-traced through the Rule-5 Y clause rather than run live. Recommended next step: stack guards in rank order and rescore the full 280-shot set under DESCENT_BOUNDS=1 DESCENT_SKIP_NOISY=1 DESCENT_MAX_SKIPS=8 DESCENT_Y_GUARD=1, gating acceptance on zero regressions among the 86 TPs (especially game-2's gap-stop TPs, whose signature — converging med_dr, fast terminal vz, no rim-height reappearance — sits outside every guard envelope proposed here). If these 17 generalize to the remaining 13 audited FPs, expected confusion shift is roughly FP 30 -> ~14, lifting decided accuracy from 74.3% toward ~80% before any FN work.
